desc:
Fighting Mechs is a sandbox PvP game where you control mechs/gundam to destroy your opponents.
How to operate said mechs? Just jump right in them and press the buttons on the back.

Join my group, if you want to see every update i make on this game.
Vote kicking for no reason, will lead to a ban
Report hackers if you see any please
I'm a solo scripter, so updates take a while, thank you for being patience

Recent update: 
- Released Necromancer
- Malice is out (Halloween Mech)
- Added "Rancor"

NOTE:
* 10 Fragment mechs
* 3 Fusion mechs
* 2 console mechs
* 3 Secret mechs
* 4 Obby Mechs
* 4 Bosses
* Jumping out of a mech, will make the mech disappear
* Bosses will spawn periodically 
* Find Gamepass mechs in Lobby
* if a mech doesn't work, then regenerate it by touching the button.
* The game is in Beta, so help out with some suggestions.
*Inspired off a old mech game I use to love playing.
*Might be hidden mechs lurking around
